items.title: John Budd interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997 [transcript only]
items.q: he had this young baseball player there, we met him

ctx.x: He owned one of the baseball teams, right?

At the time I knew him, he had bought the Kansas City team which then moved to Oakland. And he had an office in Chicago, and I’ve been there several times, and he closed his office business at four in the afternoon but at that time out in California it was only maybe two or three. He could listen and he’d talk, I remember him talking to Joe Kronin on the telephone and giving advice about things. And he had one day a young player from Ohio, Gene Tenace was his name, was a great catcher, a new player, and Charlie…
